newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Suspect held in Belgian bin-bag killer case - papers.
newsitem.headline: Suspect held in Belgian bin-bag killer case - papers.

text.p: Belgian police have arrested a suspect and identified another victim in the bin-bag serial killer case, Belgian newspapers said on Wednesday.

Since late March, a ritualistic serial killer has deposited 15 bin bags with about 30 human body parts in four places around the southern city of Mons. The body parts belong to at least four, possibly six women.
The Mons judiciary, which is due to hold a news conference at 1030 local (0830 GMT) refused all comment on the reports.

The first victim, whose torso was found in a bin bag last year, was a French woman who had worked as a prostitute. On Tuesday, a court official said it had not been established that the woman, Martine Bohn, was killed by the same murderer who deposited the body parts in the past month.
Several papers said that both the suspect and the second victim came from an impoverished background.
